facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, but foreign currency must be surrendered to an approved bank.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Only with Finance Minister authorisation after a BCEAO opinion.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Paystack Starter accepts unregistered individuals with ID and a mobile-money or bank account.
facts.L1_registration: Declare as an entreprenant at the CEPICI one-stop shop, typically 24–48 hours.
facts.L2_tax_id: Taxpayer account, issued with your tax existence declaration (DFE) at CEPICI.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Entreprenant turnover tax: 2.5% for services up to FCFA 5m, 5% to FCFA 50m.
facts.L4_vat_gst: Entreprenant taxpayers under FCFA 50m don't charge VAT.
facts.L5_data_protection: Law 2013-450: declare personal data processing to ARTCI.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Reported: 10 working days to return goods; not confirmed from the law.
facts.L7_incentives: Low turnover taxes replacing VAT and profit tax; startups may get three-year exemptions.

watch_out.text: Foreign-currency income from abroad must be surrendered to an approved bank.
Wise isn't available to residents, despite guides calling it official.
